query:
CREATE TABLE `nom035_policy_versions` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`policy_id` int NOT NULL,
	`version_number` int NOT NULL,
	`nombre` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
	`descripcion` text NOT NULL,
	`fecha_publicacion` date NOT NULL,
	`rep_legal_id` int,
	`pdf_url` text,
	`uploaded_file_name` varchar(255),
	`file_size` int,
	`change_description` text,
	`created_by` int NOT NULL,
	`created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	CONSTRAINT `nom035_policy_versions_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
	CONSTRAINT `policy_versions_policy_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`policy_id`) REFERENCES `nom035_policies`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
	CONSTRAINT `policy_versions_rep_legal_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`rep_legal_id`) REFERENCES `company_legal_representative`(`id`),
	CONSTRAINT `policy_versions_created_by_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`created_by`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`)
);
